sentences.text: Afzal Ansari vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 December, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No.1791 of 2024
Afzal Ansari ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Karan Singh Dugtal, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No. 542 of 2023, under Section 452, 376, 506 Ipc, Police
Station Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the niece of the informant was found missing from her home from 10:00 in the night on 07.12.2023.
She returned on 27.12.2023 and told that it is the applicant who once raped her and thereafter, took her to Gujarat and established physical relations with her on multiple occasions.
Learned State counsel would submit that the victim has supported the prosecution case.
6. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion is not expected of.
Arguments are being appreciated with the caveat that any observation made in this order shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the trial or in any other proceedings.
7. During the trial of the case, various questions would find answer as to how in the midnight, the victim left her home?
How could the applicant took the victim, while she was asleep?
Was the victim consenting party?
If not, why she did not raise any alarm any time?
8. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

9. The bail application is allowed.
